meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频按转录时间轴叠加上设计好的图形卡片——标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引语、侧栏、画中画等,画布可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5,原片在下面完整播放,最后渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到「graphic overlays」「on-screen graphics」等词,或要求给视频做图形包装时触发;纯字幕走 embedded-captions,意图不明先读 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我给这段口播视频加上图形卡片,做成 9:16。
say.note: 会先确认转场策略,再逐卡设计并渲染 MP4。

say.text: 把这段访谈按转录内容配上数据标注和引语卡片。
say.note: 卡片数量按视频时长和信息密度推算。

say.text: 给我这 10 分钟的播客做图形包装,画布用 16:9。
say.note: 长视频可能拆成多段子合成。

howto.what_en: Layers designed graphic overlay cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP — onto an existing talking-head or podcast clip, timed to the transcript, on a 16:9/9:16/4:5 canvas; renders MP4, clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "graphic overlays" or "on-screen graphics", or ask to package/dress up a video. Plain subtitles go to /embedded-captions; unclear intent reads /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this talking-head clip and make it 9:16.
say_en.note: Sorts render strategy, then designs cards and renders MP4.

say_en.text: Package this interview with data callouts and quote cards.
say_en.note: Card count follows duration and transcript density.

say_en.text: Give my 10-minute podcast graphic overlays on a 16:9 canvas.
say_en.note: Long videos may split into sub-compositions.
